title: maharanga fistulosa
intro: Maharanga fistulosa, commonly known as the "Malayan forest tree", is a species of plant that belongs to the family Annonaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Maharanga fistulosa include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help in relieving cough, fever, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
